title: Copa del Rey winners, 2006 to 2015
brief: Name the club that won the Copa del Rey final in each year from 2006 to 2015.

rows.name: Atletico Madrid
rows.val: beat Real Madrid 2-1 after extra time

notes.Real Zaragoza: Real Zaragoza won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2001).
notes.Deportivo: Deportivo won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2002).
notes.Mallorca: Mallorca won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2003).
notes.Real Betis: Real Betis won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2005).
notes.Real Sociedad: Real Sociedad won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2020).
notes.Athletic Bilbao: Athletic Bilbao won the Copa del Rey outside these years (2024).

checks: Every winner from 2001 to 2026 agrees between Wikipedia's list of finals and Transfermarkt's list of winners. Windows were tested for the 4-slot rule: only windows starting 2001 to 2006 pass, because Barcelona won in 2009, 2012 and every year from 2015 to 2018, and 2017, 2018, 2021 and 2025 put four Barcelona wins in the latest window. This 2006 to 2015 window overlaps the 2001 one by five years; it is the latest window that passes.
